children: New Location Marks 6th Store in California
Black Rock Coffee Bar
Black Rock Coffee Bar
Scottsdale, AZ, Sept. 01, 2026

-- Black Rock Coffee Bar, the Oregon-born boutique coffee chain celebrated for its specialty coffees, teas, smoothies, and signature Fuel® energy drinks, is growing its footprint in California with the opening of a new store in
Lake Elsinore
The store, located at
321 Summerhill Dr
, will officially open its doors on
Wednesday, September 2nd
. This opening marks Black Rock’s sixth California location and reinforces the brand’s steady expansion across the state. Guests can enjoy the following specials during opening week:
Wednesday, 9/2: Free 16oz Drinks
Thursday, 9/3: Buy One, Get One Free Drinks
Friday, 9/4: 50% Off a Drink w/ Food Purchase
Saturday, 9/5: Signature Grand Opening Sticker with purchase while supplies last
Sunday, 9/6: Free T-Shirt with purchase while supplies last
Monday, 9/7: $2 Off Any Size Drink

"Our growth in California reflects the strong support we've received from our guests across the state," said Mark Davis, CEO of Black Rock Coffee Bar. "We're excited to open our first Lake Elsinore location, connect with new customers, and continue delivering the fast, friendly service and premium beverages that define the Black Rock experience."
Guests can also take advantage of the
Black Rock Rewards app

, where every purchase—whether in-store, online, or through the app—earns “bolts” that can be redeemed for free beverages. Recent menu additions, like Black Rock’s protein-packed Egg Bites, are also included in the program.

Black Rock Coffee Bar is beloved for its handcrafted beverages, including the Caramel Blondie, a sweet and creamy signature blend; the Mexican Mocha, a spicy twist with hints of vanilla, almond, and cinnamon; and the Jackhammer, a vanilla mocha with an extra double shot; as well as its in-house-developed Fuel energy drink, customizable with over 20 fruit flavors. These can be enjoyed alongside sweet and savory food items, including the recently launched Grilled Cheese. For an extra kick of protein, guests can add Black Rock’s new Protein Cold Foam, Protein Boosted Milk or Protein Boost to their drinks.
In addition to Black Rock menu staples, guests can enjoy limited-time offerings like their Pumpkin Spiced Latte, Pumpkin Blondie, and Pumpkin Spice Cookie Latte with
Cookie Butter Cold Foam
. The brand is also featuring its Fall Remix seasonal drinks including the Caramel Apple Butter Shaken Espresso, Cinnamon Bun Latte, and Spellbound Berry Fuel.
For more information, visit
and follow @blackrockcoffeebar on Facebook and Instagram, and @blackrockcoffeeofficial on TikTok for updates on new locations, promotions, and seasonal offerings.
About Black Rock Coffee Bar

Black Rock Coffee Bar is a national boutique coffee shop that is known for its premium roasted coffees, teas, smoothies and flavorful Fuel® energy drinks. Founded as a family owned and operated business in Oregon in 2008, Black Rock Coffee Bar has grown to over 200 retail locations in seven states. The Black Rock culture prides itself on not only being a positive force for the communities it serves, but also the team members that fuel their locations day in and day out. An important aspect of their team mission is to recognize those that go above and beyond by displaying the 4G’s of Black Rock - grit, growth, gratitude, and grace. For more information, visit
